# EetKit

> EetKit is an open-source (MIT) C# and .NET library for the Czech electronic sales registration EET 2.0 (elektronická evidence tržeb, data interface v4.1, mandatory from 1 January 2027, January is a pilot period). It validates a sale, signs the SOAP message with WS-Security, sends it to the Financial Administration of the Czech Republic (playground or production), verifies the signed response and returns the POK code. NuGet packages: `EetKit` and `EetKit.Extensions.DependencyInjection`. Targets .NET 8, .NET 10 and netstandard2.0 (tested on .NET Framework 4.8). Not an official product of the Financial Administration.

Key facts:

- Entry point: `EetClient.FromPkcs12(path, password, EetEnvironment.Playground)` and `await client.SendAsync(new Trzba(...))`.
- Result `EetResult.Status`: `Confirmed` (print `Pok`), `VerifiedOnly` (verification mode), `TemporaryError` (resend later with `SendOptions(PrvniZaslani: false)`), `Rejected` (fix data or certificate).
- Invalid data throws `EetValidationException` and is never sent.
- ASP.NET Core: `services.AddEet(o => { ... })` registers a singleton `EetClient`.
- Sale fields use the Czech names of the official specification (`CelkTrzba` = `celk_trzba`, `PoradCis` = `porad_cis`, `EicPopl` = `eic_popl`).
- Only EET 2.0 (interface v4.1) is supported, not the old EET v3.

- [README (Czech)](https://github.com/Kazalax/eetkit/blob/main/README.md): installation, example, result statuses, playground, ASP.NET Core, FAQ
- [README (English)](https://github.com/Kazalax/eetkit/blob/main/README.en.md): the same in English
- [Migration from Mews.Fiscalizations.Czechia (Czech)](https://github.com/Kazalax/eetkit/blob/main/docs/prechod-z-mews-eet.md): maps the old Mews.Eet API (EET v3) to EetKit (EET 2.0)
- [Changelog](https://github.com/Kazalax/eetkit/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
